summary: The first plan-fix requirements are integrated, but deployment polling still needs a Control API GET proxy, HTTP 409 must be preserved through the proxy, and every background-job exception or timeout must persist a terminal FAILED state.
required_fixes: Add the Control API deployment-status GET proxy used by frontend polling.
Propagate all Supervisor error statuses through the Control API, including HTTP 409 Conflict.
Guarantee status=FAILED, completed_at, error_stage and sanitized error_excerpt for every timeout and unexpected background-job exception while always releasing the project lock.
preserved_requirements: Fresh dirty and branch checks at execution time.
Configured Supervisor values are authoritative for paths, branches, services and commands.
Background deployment with polling and safe frontend confirmation metadata.
Per-project locking and existing security/test requirements from plan review 01.
